rules.statement: An application for execution of a mortgage decree is not barred by section 337 of the Civil Procedure Code if it is made after an earlier application and the first application did not constitute an application under Chapter 22 of the Code.
rules.supporting_quote: It could be so regarded only if the application of September, 1941, was also an application under Chapter 22 of the Code. I do not think that the application of September, 1941, was such application.
